dct_description_sm: Contributors: United States. Bureau of the Census. Geography Division, cartographer
Publication statement: [Washington, D.C.] : U.S. Census Bureau, 2023.

This dataset is comprised of three shapefiles (1:500,000, 1:5,000,000, and 1:20,000,000). Each shapefile shows national congressional district boundaries for the 118th Congress. The difference between the three vector shapefiles is the scalar level of generalization of the boundaries (1:500,000 being the most detailed set of boundaries)
